name: Prism search
description: The six search modes of Prism: default, apps, files, commands, grep and web. Apps launch, files open in EDITOR, the web row opens BROWSER, commands are never run. It never takes the keyboard: it works inside the Prism window.

rowsPerGroup.description: Rows shown per group (apps, each file group, commands); the rest becomes a 'more' row

maxFiles.description: Files looked at per search stage before the stage stops

searchTimeMs.description: Time a search stage may take, in milliseconds; also stops slow or hung mounts

hiddenFiles.description: Match hidden files and folders inside the folders that are searched

hiddenHomeDirs.description: Also search hidden folders of the home folder other than .cache, .local and .config

systemGroup.description: Show the collapsed group of system files

systemRoots.description: Absolute folders searched for system files; /proc, /sys, /dev, /run and /tmp are never searched

commandDirs.description: Absolute folders searched for commands after the default command folders

grepMaxMatches.description: Matches after which grep stops (at most 1000 are shown)

grepCase.description: Case rule of grep: smart ignores case unless the pattern has an uppercase letter

searchUrl.description: Web search address with exactly one %s where the query goes; must start with http:// or https://

terminal.description: Terminal program for the editor and for Terminal=true applications; empty means the TERMINAL variable

terminalExecFlag.description: Flag before the command in the terminal; unset uses the known flag of the terminal, else -e
